get.description: Retrieves one or more assets by their IDs. The id parameter can be a single value or an array.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset ID(s). Can be a single value or an array.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Time to live for signed URLs in milliseconds

parameters.name: signUrl
parameters.description: Whether to sign the URL (default: true)

get.description: Retrieves a single asset by ID. Can return JSON response or redirect to the asset URL.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: If true, redirects to the asset URL instead of returning JSON

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Time to live for signed URLs in milliseconds

parameters.name: signUrl
parameters.description: Whether to sign the URL (default: true)

get.description: Lists assets and subdirectories in the specified virtual path

parameters.name: virtualPath
parameters.description: Virtual path to browse (supports wildcard patterns)

200.description: Browse response with assets and directories

get.description: Retrieves the extracted content for an asset

parameters.name: virtualPath
parameters.description: Virtual path to the asset (supports wildcard patterns)

404.description: Asset not found or no extracted content available

get.description: Retrieves a signed URL or public URL for downloading an asset. Can return JSON response or redirect to the URL.

parameters.name: virtualPath
parameters.description: Virtual path to the asset (supports wildcard patterns)

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: If true, redirects to the asset URL instead of returning JSON

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Time to live for signed URLs in milliseconds

parameters.name: signUrl
parameters.description: Whether to sign the URL (default: true)

post.description: Uploads binary data to storage. The virtualPath parameter is optional and will be auto-generated if not provided. Requires Content-Type and X-UserId headers.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Time to live for signed URLs in milliseconds

parameters.name: signUrl
parameters.description: Whether to sign the URL (default: true)

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Asset ID (if provided, will use this ID instead of generating a new one)

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Desired file path for storage (without tenantId). If omitted and assetId is provided, it will be derived from the existing asset's storagePath

parameters.name: extractContent
parameters.description: Whether to extract content from the uploaded file (e.g., extract text from PDF)

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Content type of the uploaded file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf')

parameters.name: X-UserId
parameters.description: User ID who is uploading the file

400.description: Bad request (missing Content-Type or X-UserId header, invalid tenantId or virtualPath)

post.summary: Upload binary data and JSON metadata

parameters.name: ttl

parameters.name: extractContent

parameters.name: X-UserId

requestBody.description: FormData consisting of binary file and JSON metadata

get.description: Retrieves content for a delivery item. Requires JWT authentication.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID (must match the JWT token tenant_id)

400.description: Bad request (missing or invalid tenantId, deliveryId, or itemPath)

403.description: Authorization error (tenantId does not match JWT token)

get.summary: Get references of files in a specified folder

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID (must match the JWT token tenant_id)

parameters.description: Tenant ID (must match the JWT token tenant_id)

virtualPath.description: Virtual path of file (uniquely identifies the file within its tenant)

newVirtualPath.description: Virtual path of file after moving

newStoragePath.description: Storage path of file after moving (optional)

responseId.description: Qti response identifier, as defined on authoring tool.

tenantId.description: ID for the tenant an asset belongs to

driverId.description: Storage driver ID used for storing the asset

userId.description: ID for the user an asset belongs to (or null)

storagePath.description: Internal path to the storage location

publicUrl.description: Public URL to use for downloading the asset

streamUrl.description: API URL to call to stream the asset

totalItems.description: Total items in the collection being paginated

totalPages.description: Total pages to fetch to traverse all items
